neighbours.label: hex and character-range literals in character-handling code (the 'x' of 0x20 in ord() checks, the '0' of [0-9] in regexes)

notes: Opposite (+) pole's output promotes ' char'/' character'. Probe: ord(c) >= 0x20 0.83, regex [^0-9...] 0.54, but plain 0x10 constants 0.01-0.09: hex alone is not enough, character context matters.
